Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted and reconciled sources incorrectly by deriving the birth year from age-at-death as 2023 - 53 = 1970 without accounting for the December birthday (which implies 1969 given a May 2023 death). It then suggested “prefer 3 December 1970,” contradicting both IMDb (3 December 1969) and Wikipedia (December 1969). This faulty discrepancy resolution led toward the wrong year.
